description: A minecraft mod that allows your dog to level up

mods.name: Dog Levels
mods.description: A dog leveling system mod. Dogs gain XP from combat, level up to grow stronger and bigger, and unlock new abilities at milestone levels so they stay viable in endgame.

releases.notes:
## What's new in 1.4.1

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed MAX_LEVEL liveness issue
- Fixed static predictedBehavior
- Fixed cooldown leak
- Enemy interface for splash bite
- Locale-safe formatting
- i18n improvements

### Real Networking
- SimpleChannel with DogLevelSyncMessage + ClientDogLevelCache

### Config
- All ability levels + tuning values configurable

### Commands
- setlevel/addxp/reset
- Raytrace info
- @e selectors

### QoL
- Wolves attracted to Treats (TemptGoal)

### Tests
- Ported to JUnit 5, 33 tests pass

### Other
- Fixed XP bar overlapping stats viewport
